cases.title: npm ownership and package availability
cases.description: T-01 prerequisite verification before writing package.json.
cases.steps_to_reproduce: Run npm whoami, npm access list packages @firatkill, and npm view @firatkill/outbox.
cases.expected_result: Authenticated account is firatkill, scope access succeeds, and the unpublished package returns E404.
cases.actual_result: npm whoami exited 1 with ENEEDAUTH. npm view @firatkill/outbox returned E404 as expected. Scope access was not attempted after authentication failed.
cases.environment: macOS arm64; Node v24.10.0; pnpm 10.18.3; Docker 28.5.1; Compose v2.40.2; 2026-10-21

attempts.actual_result: npm whoami exited 1 with ENEEDAUTH. npm view @firatkill/outbox returned E404 as expected. Scope access was not attempted after authentication failed.
attempts.note: Owner action required: authenticate locally, or explicitly approve deferring authenticated ownership verification. Package identity remains unchanged.
